column1: EGS is operational best-effort open-water mapping and may omit urban, forested or vegetated flooding.
The fixed reference is OBS01 EGS class 1 permanent water, not an independently observed pre-event normal-water surface.
The seven products mix 5/16/30 m sources, beam modes, orbit directions, Gamma/Sigma representations and HH/HV classifier channels.
The common 20 m grid standardizes spatial accounting but does not normalize sensor or product response.
The acquisition sequence is discrete and non-monotonic; no daily interpolation or satellite-derived flood peak is claimed.

Regional WaterOffice unit values support two hydrologic pulse windows separated by an inter-pulse low, but gauges do not validate individual pixels or provide a same-contract pre-event EGS flood frame.
OBS01 follows the first selected Chilliwack flow maximum, while OBS05 is close to the second selected maximum; these are stage alignments, not satellite peak claims.
The OBS02→OBS03 jump has mixed hydrologic and observational causes; the contribution ratio is unresolved.
Mission and Chilliwack gauges provide regional context only; the inside-AOI Cannor station lacks December 2025 daily data.
Folly Lake values are empirical method-variability context, not universal thresholds or significance tests.
Road and bridge results depend on OSM geometry/tag completeness and indicate potential exposure only.
ALR is a legal designation and cannot identify active crops, crop loss or agricultural damage.
Official place points are contextual locations, not population-exposure surfaces.
Sentinel-2 recovery comparison has a 6.2-day timing offset.
